headline: kakuteki surges from 1,748th to 78th on ARC-2

sections.text: kakuteki gained 6.66 points to reach 33.19, jumping from 1,748th to 78th on the ARC-2 public board. The move puts the team inside the top 100.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
